subject: Adversarial fact-check of the NeuroML v2 schema / LEMS / libNeuroML / jLEMS verification report (neuroml-lems.research.json), 2026-09-13

checks.claim: Newest numbered NeuroML v2 XSD; same file list on master and development; no v2.4
checks.reported_value: NeuroML_v2.0, v2.1, v2.2, v2.3, v2.3.1 (+ v2alpha, v2beta..v2beta5); newest v2.3.1; no v2.4
checks.verified_value: Schemas/NeuroML2 on master (commit a5f5dad, 2026-09-02) and origin/development list the same 12 XSDs: v2.0, v2.1, v2.2, v2.3, v2.3.1, v2alpha, v2beta, v2beta1-5. No v2.4 and no v2.3.2 XSD. git diff master..development on Schemas/NeuroML2 and NeuroML2CoreTypes is empty. HISTORY.md does differ between the branches (see additional findings).
checks.method: git clone --depth 1 --no-single-branch https://github.com/NeuroML/NeuroML2.git; ls Schemas/NeuroML2/*.xsd; git ls-tree origin/development Schemas/NeuroML2/; git diff --stat origin/master origin/development -- Schemas/NeuroML2 NeuroML2CoreTypes

checks.claim: Raw v2.3.1 XSD location, size and targetNamespace
checks.reported_value: raw URL, 182554 bytes, targetNamespace http://www.neuroml.org/schema/neuroml2
checks.verified_value: The raw download is 182554 bytes with targetNamespace http://www.neuroml.org/schema/neuroml2. The Windows clone copy is 186517 bytes only because core.autocrlf=true converts line endings. Hash the raw download, not a checkout.
checks.method: curl -s <raw url> -o api/NeuroML_v2.3.1.xsd; wc -c; grep -o targetNamespace

checks.claim: HISTORY.md top release entry and schema rename

checks.claim: Core input ComponentTypes in NeuroML2CoreTypes/Inputs.xml
checks.reported_value: 6 base types + spikeGenerator..voltageClampTriple (25 names)
checks.verified_value: Exactly the 25 names reported, identical on master and development. Parent types: pulse/ramp/sine/compoundInput extend basePointCurrent; their DL variants extend basePointCurrentDL; voltageClamp and voltageClampTriple extend baseVoltageDepPointCurrent.
checks.method: grep -o '<ComponentType name=...extends=...' Inputs.xml

checks.claim: pulseGenerator parameters and semantics
checks.reported_value: delay, duration, amplitude; weight default 1; i=weight*amplitude for delay<=t<delay+duration else 0
checks.verified_value: Matches the source: Parameters delay, duration, amplitude; Property weight defaultValue 1. Three OnCondition blocks set i to 0 before delay, weight*amplitude inside the window and 0 after it.
checks.method: python regex extraction of the ComponentType block

checks.claim: rampGenerator parameters and semantics
checks.reported_value: delay, duration, start/finish/baselineAmplitude; baseline outside window, linear inside; scaled by weight
checks.verified_value: Matches, with one detail. OnStart sets i = baselineAmplitude without the weight factor. The OnConditions then use weight*baselineAmplitude outside the window and weight*(start + (finish-start)*(t-delay)/duration) inside it.
checks.method: python regex extraction of the ComponentType block

checks.claim: sineGenerator parameters and semantics
checks.reported_value: delay, duration, amplitude, period, phase; weight*amplitude*sin(phase+2*pi*(t-delay)/period) with 3.14159265; no sweep
checks.verified_value: Matches exactly: pi is written as 3.14159265 and the period is a fixed Parameter.
checks.method: python regex extraction of the ComponentType block

checks.claim: compoundInput semantics
checks.reported_value: Children currents of basePointCurrent; i = weight * sum
checks.verified_value: Matches: DerivedVariable i_total selects currents[*]/i with reduce=add, and i = weight * i_total.
checks.method: python regex extraction of the ComponentType block

checks.claim: No core chirp, noise-current or arbitrary waveform input; issue search 0
checks.reported_value: absent; issue search 'waveform' 0 issues
checks.verified_value: Core types: no such ComponentType. The only 'waveform' hits are the waveformFactor derived parameters in Synapses.xml. Issue search, now authenticated: 'waveform' 0 and 'chirp' 0. But 'noise current' returns 2 OPEN feature requests: #99 'Add new noisy current sources' and #97 'Add NeuroML implementation of PyNN's NoisyCurrentSource'. So noise inputs are requested but not implemented; the report's negative issue evidence was incomplete.
checks.method: grep -il chirp|waveform|timeseries|noise NeuroML2CoreTypes/*.xml; gh api search/issues q='repo:NeuroML/NeuroML2 waveform' / 'chirp' / 'noise current'

checks.claim: Users may define their own ComponentTypes

checks.verified_value: Documentation source NeuroMLv2AndLEMS.md line 28 says this.

checks.claim: XSD Nml2Quantity_current lexical pattern
checks.reported_value: optional minus, units A, uA, nA, pA only
checks.verified_value: XSD line 102 pattern: -?([0-9]*(\.[0-9]+)?)([eE]-?[0-9]+)?[\s]*(A|uA|nA|pA). Exercised through libNeuroML 0.6.7 component_factory('PulseGenerator', ...): '-0.1nA' and '0.2 pA' are accepted; '1mA' and '5 microA' raise ValueError (does not match xsd pattern).
checks.method: grep -n -A4 Nml2Quantity_current; venv python component_factory test

checks.claim: How inputs attach to cells (XSD)
checks.reported_value: explicitInput(target,input,destination); inputList(population,component; input target,destination,segmentId,fractionAlong; inputW weight)
checks.verified_value: Confirmed. InputW extends Input with a required attribute weight (xs:float). libNeuroML exposes ExplicitInput, InputList, Input and InputW classes.
checks.method: grep complexType ExplicitInput/InputList/Input/InputW; hasattr(neuroml, ...)

checks.claim: LEMS Simulation ComponentType and time step
checks.reported_value: Parameters length, step; Text seed; target; Children displays, outputs, events, metas; OutputColumn SI
checks.verified_value: Simulation.xml: Parameter length (time), Parameter step (time, dt), ComponentReference target, Text seed; Children metas(Meta), displays(Display), outputs(OutputFile), events(EventOutputFile). EventOutputFile format is TIME_ID or ID_TIME. The OutputColumn description says quantities are saved in SI units.
checks.method: grep ComponentType/Parameter/Text/Children in Simulation.xml

checks.claim: Meta ComponentType fields
checks.reported_value: for, method, abs_tolerance, rel_tolerance
checks.verified_value: Text for (simulator name), method, abs_tolerance and rel_tolerance (both described as NEURON cvode tolerances), at lines 106-110.

checks.claim: NEURON exporter honours Meta method=cvode and tolerances
checks.reported_value: NeuronWriter reads method==cvode and abs_tolerance (lines ~344-362)
checks.verified_value: Master 91016a2, lines 359-363: if method equals 'cvode', it sets nrn_cvode and reads abs_tolerance and rel_tolerance. Caveat: this is org.neuroml.export master (1.10.1), while the jar bundled in pyNeuroML 1.3.22 contains org.neuroml.export 1.11.0 (development). The development copy of NeuronWriter was not diffed.
checks.method: grep -n cvode|abs_tolerance|rel_tolerance NeuronWriter.java

checks.claim: jLEMS RUN.java integration constants and default
checks.reported_value: EULER=1, RK4=2, static method=RK4
checks.verified_value: RUN.java lines 6-9: EULER = 1, RK4 = 2, method = RK4. No assignment to RUN.method exists anywhere else in jLEMS, org.neuroml.export or jNeuroML sources. The bundled RUN.class (jlems 0.12.0) has an iconst_2/putstatic byte pair and no iconst_1/putstatic pair, consistent with the default RK4 (weak byte-level check, not a decompilation).
checks.method: grep -n in clone 1ae9e8b; grep -rn 'RUN.method\s*='; python zipfile scan of bundled jar

checks.claim: StateInstance.advance: RK4 only for flattened state types, else Euler
checks.reported_value: if stateType.flattened && RK4 -> rk4Advance else eulerAdvance; comment on consolidated instances
checks.verified_value: Lines 283-289 match. The StateType.java comment above rk4Advance (lines 512-519) says it works only on consolidated or flattened instances.
checks.method: sed -n 280,292p StateInstance.java; sed -n 510,520p StateType.java

checks.claim: Flattening requires Dynamics simultaneous=true
checks.reported_value: makeConsolidatedStateType flattens only if simultaneous; flattened=true only in makeFlattened; Dynamics.simultaneous default false; hhcell.xml uses it
checks.verified_value: Confirmed. makeConsolidatedStateType (line 970) calls getFlattenedStateType if simultaneous, otherwise makeChildConsolidated. ret.flattened = true only at line 1085 in makeFlattened. Dynamics.java line 46 sets simultaneous = false. simultaneous="true" appears in src/test/resources/hhcell.xml and hhchannel.xml.
checks.method: grep/sed in clone; grep -rln 'simultaneous="true"' src/test/resources

checks.claim: No NeuroML2 core ComponentType uses simultaneous; LEMS_v0.7.6.xsd does not define it
checks.reported_value: 0 matches in core XML files; 0 in LEMS_v0.7.6.xsd
checks.verified_value: 0 matches across NeuroML2CoreTypes (master) and 0 in LEMS_v0.7.6.xsd. The 10 NeuroML2CoreTypes XML files bundled inside the pyNeuroML 1.3.22 jar also contain no 'simultaneous'.
checks.method: grep -ril simultaneous NeuroML2CoreTypes; grep -ic LEMS_v0.7.6.xsd; zipfile scan of jar

checks.claim: Sim.run defaults and Meta method values
checks.reported_value: run() -> run(true); runTree() -> run(false); Meta rk4 sets flatten, eulertree unsets, else warn
checks.verified_value: Sim.java lines 144-218 match. Because run() already passes flatten=true, Meta method='rk4' changes nothing under jnml's sim.run(). Meta method='eulertree' does change the path: it skips getConsolidatedStateType and runs the raw tree (still Euler). The bundled Sim.class contains the strings rk4, eulertree, 'unrecognized method ' and 'checking metas'.
checks.method: sed -n 140,232p Sim.java; zipfile string scan of bundled Sim.class

checks.claim: jnml runs LEMS via Utils.runLemsFile -> loadLemsFile -> sim.run() after a feature check
checks.reported_value: JNeuroML.java -> Utils.runLemsFile -> loadLemsFile -> sim.run()
checks.verified_value: Confirmed in source. JNeuroML.java lines 387/622 call Utils.runLemsFile. Utils.loadLemsFile runs SupportLevelInfo.checkConversionSupported(Format.LEMS, ...) and then sim.run() (line 568). Read from org.neuroml.export master (1.10.1), not the bundled 1.11.0.
checks.method: sed -n 529,570p Utils.java; grep JNeuroML.java

checks.claim: Inference: jnml integrates standard NeuroML models with fixed-step forward Euler
checks.reported_value: Source-reading inference, not executed
checks.verified_value: Every source premise checks out: code at jLEMS master 1ae9e8b and tag v0.11.1, and the integrator files are unchanged on development (0.12.0, the version actually bundled). Byte-level string checks of the bundled classes agree. The conclusion itself could not be executed: Java is not installed (bash: 'java: command not found'), and installing it was not permitted. Keep it as an M1 test.
checks.method: git diff --stat v0.11.1 HEAD and HEAD origin/development on RUN/StateInstance/StateType/Sim/Dynamics (empty); java -version

corrections_summary: Most of the report holds up against primary sources: schema and LEMS versions, release dates, licenses, input ComponentType semantics, the XSD unit pattern, the jLEMS Euler/RK4 source logic, PyPI metadata and citations. Corrections: (1) jLEMS 0.11.1 is only the newest GitHub release. The jNeuroML 0.14.0 jar in pyNeuroML 1.3.22 contains jlems 0.12.0, an untagged development-branch version, and org.neuroml.export/model 1.11.0, not export 1.10.1 with jLEMS 0.11.1. (2) The Scientific Committee has 12 members, not 11. (3) The LEMSSimulation signature omitted the required sim_id argument plus comment and lems_file_generate_seed. (4) libNeuroML validate_neuroml2/is_valid_neuroml2 are generateDS object validation, not XSD validation; XSD validation through pynml needs Java. (5) The Board 'tests' reference implementations; it is not described as managing them. Unverifiable: the forward-Euler conclusion. Its source premises hold for 0.11.1, master and 0.12.0, but it could not be run without Java. The report also missed: two open noise-current feature requests (#97, #99), the v2.3.2 placeholder in development HISTORY, the eulertree Meta nuance and CRLF effects on XSD hashes.
additional_findings: The Java runtime inside pyNeuroML 1.3.22 does not match the GitHub release tags. Its jNeuroML-0.14.0-jar-with-dependencies.jar (SHA-256 45ee565a65a66008a3b41935358d11b7c19cb6b5a67bbec22481d519f53db931, 28904516 bytes) contains jlems 0.12.0 and org.neuroml.export, import and model 1.11.0. jLEMS 0.12.0 exists only as the jLEMS development-branch pom version: no GitHub tag or release, and no Maven Central path (HTTP 404). Record the jLEMS provenance as 'jlems 0.12.0 from the jNeuroML 0.14.0 jar', not 0.11.1. Sources: https://github.com/LEMS/jLEMS/blob/development/pom.xml ; https://github.com/NeuroML/org.neuroml.export/blob/development/pom.xml ; https://pypi.org/project/pyNeuroML/1.3.22/

The jLEMS integrator source files (RUN, StateInstance, StateType, Sim, Dynamics) are identical at tag v0.11.1, master 1ae9e8b and development 35bafd3 (0.12.0). The report's Euler/RK4 source analysis therefore carries over to the bundled 0.12.0, though it is still not executed. https://github.com/LEMS/jLEMS/compare/master...development

Mutation-design nuance: jnml calls Sim.run(), which already uses the consolidated (flatten=true) path. Meta method='rk4' should be a no-op. Meta method='eulertree' switches to the raw, unconsolidated state tree, so it may NOT be a no-op (evaluation order could change while staying Euler). Either way this is a source reading, to be tested in M1. https://github.com/LEMS/jLEMS/blob/master/src/main/java/org/lemsml/jlems/core/sim/Sim.java

libNeuroML validate_neuroml2 and is_valid_neuroml2 do not validate against the XSD with lxml; they run generateDS object validation. Full XSD validation goes through pyneuroml.pynml.validate_neuroml2, which shells out to jnml -validate and needs Java. Without Java only the generateDS check is available, and it does catch unit-pattern errors (e.g. '1mA' is rejected). https://github.com/NeuralEnsemble/libNeuroML/blob/master/neuroml/utils.py

The NeuroML2 development branch HISTORY.md has an empty placeholder entry 'v2.3.2 / 2025-x-x', so a v2.3.2 schema release is anticipated. No v2.3.2 XSD exists yet. Pin validity to NeuroML_v2.3.1.xsd and re-check before freezing. https://github.com/NeuroML/NeuroML2/blob/development/HISTORY.md

Two OPEN feature requests exist for noise current inputs in NeuroML2: #97 ('Add NeuroML implementation of PyNN's NoisyCurrentSource') and #99 ('Add new noisy current sources'). This matters for handoff protocol 12 (frozen pseudo-random waveform): no core type exists today. https://github.com/NeuroML/NeuroML2/issues/97 ; https://github.com/NeuroML/NeuroML2/issues/99

pyNeuroML 1.3.22 and pyLEMS 0.6.9 both declare requires_python null on PyPI. pyNeuroML classifiers list Python 3.10-3.14; pyLEMS lists 3.8-3.14; libNeuroML 0.6.7 lists 3.9-3.13. The intersection with classifier support for all three is Python 3.10-3.13. https://pypi.org/pypi/pyNeuroML/json ; https://pypi.org/pypi/pylems/json ; https://pypi.org/pypi/libNeuroML/json

The raw NeuroML_v2.3.1.xsd is 182554 bytes, but a Windows git checkout with core.autocrlf=true gives 186517 bytes. File hashes for provenance must come from raw downloads or checkouts with autocrlf disabled. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NeuroML/NeuroML2/master/Schemas/NeuroML2/NeuroML_v2.3.1.xsd
